data.body_html:
Combine wildlife spotting with a relaxed brunch on the water during our dolphin watching brunch cruise in Marbella 2038. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 2-hour tour takes you along the Costa del Sol coastline where pods of wild dolphins are frequently seen. You'll enjoy complimentary drinks and light snacks while a licensed skipper navigates the calm Mediterranean waters. It's a perfect morning activity for families, couples, or small groups looking for a memorable experience without a full-day commitment.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise?

This experience combines two of Marbella's best offerings: the chance to see dolphins in their natural habitat and a relaxed brunch on a luxury motor yacht. Unlike longer charters, the 2-hour duration fits easily into a morning itinerary, leaving the rest of the day free for exploring or beach time. The tour departs from Puerto Banús, the iconic marina lined with superyachts and designer boutiques, and cruises towards Cabopino or Cala del Faro where dolphins often gather. With a maximum of 11 guests, the atmosphere remains intimate and personal.

What to Expect on Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

Your cruise begins at Puerto Banús. After a brief safety introduction, the skipper heads west along the coast. Within 20–30 minutes, you'll reach areas known for dolphin activity – typically between the Río Verde estuary and Cabopino dunes. Dolphins here include bottlenose and common dolphins, often swimming alongside the boat. Meanwhile, your brunch is served: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks such as olives, crisps, and nuts. You're welcome to bring your own camera or phone for photos – the skipper will often slow down or circle to give you the best view.

Our Fleet for This Experience

We offer two boats for the dolphin watching brunch cruise, both departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, up to 9 passengers. A sleek Spanish-built motor yacht with a spacious sundeck and comfortable seating.
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, up to 11 passengers. An Italian classic with a large cockpit area and good visibility for wildlife spotting.

Both boats are equipped with safety gear, a licensed skipper, and a sound system. For larger groups or a more premium experience, consider our full boat rental options.

Pricing and Inclusions

The dolphin watching brunch cruise is priced at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. This covers:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden fees – just show up at Puerto Banús and enjoy. If you'd like a longer cruise or a different boat, check our other experiences.

Best Time for Dolphin Watching in Marbella

Dolphin sightings peak from April to October when sea temperatures are warmer and fish are abundant. Morning departures (9:00–11:00) offer calm seas and low wind, making it easier to spot dolphins. Afternoon trips are also possible, though the sea breeze can pick up. Even in winter, dolphins are present, though sightings are less predictable. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance to secure your preferred slot.

How to Book Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

Booking is simple – just send us a WhatsApp message via our website with your preferred date, number of guests (up to 9 on Astondoa 40 or 11 on Azimut 39), and any special requests (e.g., dietary requirements). We'll confirm availability and send payment details. Full payment is required to secure the booking. Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. For last-minute bookings, contact us directly – we sometimes have same-day availability.

What to Bring

Essentials for your dolphin watching brunch cruise:

  • Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
  • Sunglasses and a hat
  • Camera or smartphone
  • Light jacket or windbreaker (especially in spring/autumn)
  • Swimwear if you plan to dip – though the tour is primarily cruising, some skippers allow a quick swim in calm bays

What is included in the dolphin watching brunch cruise?

The cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just need to bring sunscreen and a camera.

How long is the dolphin watching tour?

The standard dolphin watching brunch cruise lasts 2 hours. This is enough time to cruise along the Marbella coastline, spot dolphins, and enjoy your drinks and snacks.

Which boats are used for this experience?

We use the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers), both departing from Puerto Banús. Both are comfortable and well-equipped for dolphin watching.

When is the best time to see dolphins in Marbella?

Dolphin sightings are most common from April to October, when the sea is calm and dolphins are active. Morning departures (9:00–11:00) offer the best light and wildlife activity.

Can I bring my own food or drinks?

Our brunch cruise already includes drinks and snacks, so additional food is not necessary. However, you are welcome to bring your own if you wish – just check with the skipper first.

What happens if we don't see dolphins?

We operate in areas known for dolphin activity, and sightings are very common in season. If no dolphins are spotted, we offer a complimentary second trip on another day, subject to availability.

Is the cruise suitable for children?

Yes, the cruise is family-friendly. Children are welcome on board. Life jackets are available for all ages, and the skipper will ensure a safe, enjoyable experience.

How do I book the dolphin watching brunch cruise?

You can book directly via WhatsApp through our website. Simply send a message with your preferred date, number of guests, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and send payment details.
